used.citation: server.js:4 requires express and the whole application hangs off it

unused.reason: chalk is declared in package.json dependencies but no file in the fixture requires or imports it

forbidden.reason: eslint is a devDependency of a fixture whose code never imports it; a vulnerability finding on it would have to be justified, and none of its pinned line carries an advisory the fixture cares about

packages.citation: server.js:4 uses express at run time, so the shipped artifact carries it
chalk sits in dependencies, so an install ships it even though the code never uses it
eslint sits in devDependencies, so it must not ship with the artifact
